# Shipwright Studio

> Shipwright Studio is an independent engineering studio crafting websites, web apps, and AI infrastructure for startups and small teams. Based in the San Francisco Bay Area, working worldwide. Founded and run by a senior software engineer.

## Services

- **Custom website development**: Fast, accessible, search-friendly marketing sites and landing pages. Modern stack, no bloated templates.
- **Web application development**: Interactive dashboards, internal tools, and customer-facing apps — designed, engineered, and deployed end to end.
- **AI infrastructure**: LLM application engineering, inference cost optimization, GPU communication and distributed training performance.

## Selected work

- **Lumen** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lumen/): An interactive photography lab that teaches the exposure triangle (aperture, shutter speed, ISO) with real-time canvas simulations of depth of field, motion blur, noise, and light metering.
- **Forge** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/forge/): An LLM inference cost estimator. Enter model size, quantization, GPU type, batch size, and traffic to estimate GPU count, latency, and monthly serving cost.
- **The Lab** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/ideas/): An open bank of 92 web experiments — games, developer tools, browser extension prototypes, and small apps. Two new experiments are designed, built, and shipped every day. Recent additions: **Key Inspector** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/key-inspector/), a free online keyboard event inspector — press any key to see its code, key, keyCode and modifiers, with a key history log and touch-friendly virtual keys, all in the browser, **Airdrop Checker Template** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/airdrop-checker/), a free online airdrop eligibility checker template — paste a wallet address and run it against an editable rule set with a per-rule pass/fail breakdown, demo data only, **Joke Machine** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/joke-machine/), a free online programmer joke machine — 32 jokes across four categories with punchline reveal, a groan-scale rating and session stats, all in the browser, **Stablecoin Depeg Monitor** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/depeg-monitor/), a free online stablecoin depeg monitor — simulated peg-deviation dashboard with price charts, status badges and custom alert thresholds, demo data only, **Asteroids** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/asteroids/), a free online Asteroids-style arcade game — vector-outline ship, inertia physics, splitting rocks, levels and a local high score, all in the browser, **Aspect Ratio Calc** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/aspect-ratio/), a free online aspect ratio calculator — enter one dimension to fit any ratio, with presets, a live preview box and common resolutions, all computed locally, **PX ⇄ REM Converter** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/px-rem/), a free online tool that converts pixels to rem units and back at any root font size, with a quick reference table and a copy-ready CSS snippet generator, **DAO Voting Power Viz** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/dao-voting-viz/), a free online DAO voting power visualizer — paste token holder balances to chart voting-power shares and see concentration stats (top-holder shares, Herfindahl index, Nakamoto coefficient) plus the smallest coalition that reaches a chosen passing threshold, **Quote Machine** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/quote-generator/), a free online quote generator — 59 aphorisms from Stoics to startups, shuffled-deck draws with no repeats, category filters and a daily quote, all in the browser, **Contract Event Decoder** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/event-decoder/), a free online EVM event log decoder — paste an ABI and a log to decode Transfer and other contract events with exact BigInt values, all computed locally, **Pipe Loop** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/pipe-loop/), a free online pipe connection puzzle game — rotate the tiles to connect the whole grid, with three grid sizes, a move counter and timer, all in the browser, **Fluid Type Calc** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/fluid-type/), a free online fluid typography calculator — enter min/max font sizes and viewport widths and get a clamp() expression with a live preview, all computed locally
